description_paragraphs: Set in the magical city of Seattle, this 90s favorite is a fine film for back-to-school season. Kat stratford is a smart young lady who would be quite the catch if she wasn't so deliberately abrasive towards all of her suitors. This especially bothers her younger sister Bianca, who isn't allowed to date until her older sister has a boyfriend. But the charmingly geeky Cameron hatches a plan in his quest for Bianca's heart, scheming to pair Kat with handsome bad boy Patrick Verona. Julia Styles and Heath Ledger lead this teenage update of The Taming of the Shrew, shot largely in Seattle.

description_paragraphs: This crime caper comedy mixes upbeat wit with deliciously dark humor, a difficult balance achieved with aplomb. British gangster George Thomason and his accomplice Ken team up with a pair of arrogant Americans for a massive diamond heist. When the theft goes sideways, George ends up on trial while his fellow thieves try to hunt down the hidden stash. Their plan involves sending American grifter Wanda to seduce George's stuffy lawyer Archie Leech, hoping to discover where George hid the loot. But Archie is bored with family and job and may be a more willing accomplice than Wanda suspected, especially when the chemistry between them is more than just a con job. A Fish Called Wanda is a smart and silly crowd pleaser. Winner of many accolades including an Oscar for Kevin Kline's role as a dispicable thief, the film rests on many "best of" lists, and is mong Central Cinema staff member Doug's favorite movies.

raw.calendar_title: Baron Von Terror Presents: A Nightmare on Elm Street 3: Dream Warriors
description_paragraphs: A psychiatrist, familiar with the knife-wielding dream demon Freddy Krueger, helps teens at a mental hospital battle the killer who is invading their dreams. That's the official description. But Baron Von Terror knows there's a lot more to this fan favorite Freddy film. Nightmare 3 changed the series, having each dream bring its own unique brand of terror, with plenty of unique pracitcal effects on display. From a puppeteer to a memorable snake monster, Freddy changes forms to fit each child's psyche. But the kids learn to play that game, too, using their dreams to give them the powers to fight Freddy. See Freddy fight a wizard. See a grown man fight Freddy's bones. See one kid realize her prime-time dream of being in television. Nine-Ten, you'll want to watch it again!

description_paragraphs: Throughout his life Edward Bloom has always been a man of big appetites, enormous passions and tall tales. In his later years, he remains a huge mystery to his son, William. Now, to get to know the real man, Will begins piecing together a true picture of his father from flashbacks of his amazing adventures. Central Cinema staff memeber Zoe embraces Big Fish as "imagination come to life." Tim Burton's love of besplendid visuals and offbeat misfits plays perfectly into the story of a storyteller who's truths may or may not be rooted in reality. It's a great September Staff Pick for the big screen.

description_paragraphs: Do you love movies and want to find others who can talk endlessly about them? Come join Cinemancy! Each month, a new movie is carefully selected. After the film the audience gathers to discuss themes, characters, plot, and symbolism. Hosted by Isabella Price. Amelie Amélie is the sweet tale of a woman with a gift for helping those around her find happiness and romance. She herself, however, struggles to win the heart of the good-hearted man who captures her fancy. Audrey Tautou instantly became one of France's most in demand actresses thanks to her charm and honesty in the title role. The film is filled with visual delights, thanks to the imaginaiton and eye of director Jean-Pierre Jeunet.

description_paragraphs:
THESE BEAVERS DON’T QUIT!
While the good folx at The Grand Illusion Cinema locate a new home, they’ll host their monthly Hundreds of Beavers screenings at Central Cinema.
In this 19th century, supernatural winter epic, a drunken applejack salesman must go from zero to hero and become North America’s greatest fur trapper by defeating hundreds of beavers.
Created by Mike Cheslik and Ryland Brickson Cole Tews, the duo behind the modern cult hit LAKE MICHIGAN MONSTER (2018).

description_paragraphs: The hit cult musical hits both the screen and the stage at the same time, thanks to the good folx with Ethereal Chaos Productions. When warmhearted Seymour Krelborn comes across a tiny plant with teeth, he brings it to the flower shop where he works and helps it grow to full size. With this particular plant, full size means being able to speak and sing, with a mouth big enough to swallow a (redacted for spoilers) whole. Meanwhile, Seymour is fallign in love with the girl of his dreams, but as the plant grows, so does a danger that could bring the good times to a unexpected end. How unexpected is the ending? Well, there were two endings shot for this movie, and we're not telling you which one you're in for :) The movie comes with a top notch cast and soundtrack. Ethereal Chaos Productions' shadow-cast brings the fun to life beyond the screen for an out-of-this-world event screening.

description_paragraphs: Leonard Shelby is tracking down the man who murdered his wife. The difficulty of locating his wife's killer, however, is compounded by the fact that he suffers from a rare, untreatable form of short-term memory loss. Although he can recall details of life before his accident, Leonard cannot remember what happened fifteen minutes ago, where he's going, or why. Christopher Nolan's breakout feature tells its tale in a truly unique fashion, unraveling the mystery by revealing the scenes in reverse order. Nolan's cienamtic skill comes through from an early age (he shot the film when he was 29), making for an exciting night at the movies. Memento is a personal favorite of Central Cinema staff member Kevin, and a great film to kick off September's Staff Picks.

description_paragraphs: After a two year sold-out worldwide tour, Conner4Real is the biggest name in music. Now, he's letting the fans in by way of a documentary about the release and tour for his sophomore album. But the album and new tour don't roll out as planned, leaving fans, sycophants, and rivals all wondering what to do when Conner is no longer the dopest star in the world. Ten years ago, The Lonely Island released Popstar to critical acclaim. The audiences who saw the film adored it. But like their previous effort Hot Rod, the box office was small for this future comedy cult classic. Of course, it found many fans since the decade after its release, and is worth seeing in the theater to appreciate the spectacle and soundtrack on a larger scale.

description_paragraphs: Another fine entry in the "Shakespear set in high school" subset of films hits our screen, thanks to September's Staff Picks. Viola Hastings is in a real jam, but is it really her fault? Okay, maybe pretending to be her twin brother Sebastian so she can play soccer at an exclusive boarding school isn't the most thought out plan. It is probably also a bad idea to start crushing on her roommate, especially if he's in love with someone else. Oh, and that someone else is Olivia, who starts falling for Sebastian, who is actually Viola in disguise. And of course when all of this is coming to a head, the actual Sebastian desides he's done with his trip aborad and plans to return to school, not knowing his sister is there in his place. Twelfth Night meets twelfth grade in a film that was essential viewing at sleepovers for Central Cinema staff member Sally. She also believe's it's a great film for any soccer fans who still crave some post-FIFA action.

description_paragraphs: Catholic schoolgirl Mary Katherine Gallagher wants one thing in life: a kiss. Not just any kiss - a big-time, hold-your-breath-'til'-you-think-you-may-faint kind of kiss. But no matter how hard she tries, she just can't get any of the boys she crushes on to send their lips her way. Mary Katherine decides there's only one way she's ever going to get her Hollywood romance level smooch: she must become like the people she sees get those kisses in the movies. When Catholic Teen Magazine sponsors a talent contest at her school, MKG might just make her dreams come true and become a...wait for it...SUPERSTAR! Molly Shannon delivers one of the more endearing films based on an SNL character, with a genuine sweetness coming through amidst the comedy. Will Ferrell is charming as her main crush. All this comedy is in good hands with director Bruce McCulloch (Kids In the Hall). The sweet and silly script is the kind where fans "know all the words" according to Central Cinema staff member Zoe, who chose this as a September Staff Pick, also noting the amazing soundtrack.

All this comedy is in good hands with director Bruce McCulloch (Kids In the Hall).  The sweet and silly script is the kind where fans "know all the words" according to Central Cinema staff member Zoe, who chose this as a September Staff Pick, also noting the amazing soundtrack.
schema_org.name: Superstar

description_paragraphs: John Sayles crafted this low-budget gem paralleling the immigrant experience in America. Crash landing on Ellis Island, The Brother (portrayed by the ever-talented Joe Morton) is a mute space alien resembling a Black human man. With the help of his community, he secures housing and employment. Meanwhile, bounty hunters are attempting to capture him regardless of the fact that he's a valued contrubuting member of his new society. When Central Cinema staff member Liz picked the film for September's Staff Picks, her second choice was "any other John Sayles movie." While all are worthy additions to cinema, it's Liz's first choice that feels incredibly powerful and relevent in this day and age. Central Cinema's brick and mortar surroundings may be the perfect environment for experiencing this cinematic cult favorite.

description_paragraphs: Don Bluth unleashed one of the most powerful animated films of the 80s with this thrilling adventure, which has stuck in the minds of many children well into their adult years. Mrs. Brisby, a widowed mouse, must move her children from their home in a field before the local farmer begins plowing into it. Unable to leave because her son is ill, she seeks the help of some nearby rats. However her simple request for help begins to uncover a deeper mystery into the origins of the hyper-intelligent rats - a mystery which is tied to her late husband. As secrets come to light, Mrs. Brisby must use her wits to not only help her family, but to survive a growing conflict among the rats of NIMH.

description_paragraphs: Legendary marshal Wyatt Earp, now a weary gunfighter, joins his brothers Morgan and Virgil to pursue their collective fortune in the thriving mining town of Tombstone. But Earp is forced to don a badge again and get help from his notorious pal Doc Holliday when a gang of renegade brigands and rustlers begins terrorizing the town. Tombstone overcame some serious behind-the-scenes turmoil to become one of the most memorable movies from the early 90s. Val Kilmer gives what may be his best performance as Doc Holliday, with quotable lines delivered flawlessly from beneath his amazing mustache. Central Cinema staff member Jeremy submitted this Staff Pick with the perfect review of this audience pleasing western: "Who doesn't love Tombstone?"
